record.question: As per the provisions of the Contract Labour (Regulation and abolition) Act, 1970, which of the following is a consequence of non- registration or revocation of registration of an establishment?
options: The principal employer is liable to pay a fine of Rs. 5000
The establishment is exempted from complying with the provisions of the Act
The principal employer is prohibited from employing contract labour in the establishment
The principal employer is required to take compensation to the contract labour
